name: Judo Capital Holdings Limited
summary: Judo Capital Holdings Limited, through its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services for small and medium businesses in Australia. It provides personal, self-managed super fund (SMSF), and business term deposits. It also offers line of credit, business, equipment, home, and agribusiness loans, as well as healthcare and asset financing. In addition, it provides residential mortgages, and bank guarantees. Further, it offers acquisition, wholesale, expansion, and working capital funding, as well as judo business, and warehouse lending. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Melbourne, Australia.
